title: Han Xin at Jingxing
summary: Following the Shiji: Zhao waits at the exit of the Jingxing defile. Li Zuoche's plan to trap the Han army in the defile is rejected; Han Xin deploys with his back to the river, draws Zhao out of its camp and takes it with two thousand riders hidden behind a hill.
sources: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》, from 信與張耳以兵數萬 to 禽趙王歇 (sources/jingxing-shiji.md)

zh.title: 韩信：井陉之战
zh.summary: 据《史记》：赵军在井陉峡道出口等候。李左车主张把汉军困在峡道之中，未被采纳；韩信背水列阵，诱赵军倾营而出，再以伏于山后的二千轻骑夺取赵营。
sources: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》，自“信与张耳以兵数万”至“禽赵王歇”（原文见 sources/jingxing-shiji.md）

places.name: Niangzi Pass
places.note: Where the road from Shanxi enters the Jingxing defile; shown for orientation.

zh.name: 娘子关
zh.note: 山西来路进入井陉峡道之处，标出以便定位。

places.name: Jingxing defile
places.note: The road through the Taihang along the Mian river. Li Zuoche describes it: 'carts cannot drive two abreast, horsemen cannot ride in ranks', so an army's supplies must trail far behind it.

zh.name: 井陉道
zh.note: 沿绵河穿越太行山的道路。李左车说：“井陉之道，车不得方轨，骑不得成列”，大军的粮草必然远远落在后面。

places.name: Han camp
places.note: Han Xin halts 'thirty li short of the Jingxing exit'. Position approximate.

zh.name: 汉军营地
zh.note: 韩信“未至井陉口三十里，止舍”。位置为约略。

places.name: Zhao fortified camp
places.note: Chen Yu's army, 'said to be 200,000', holds the eastern exit of the defile where it opens onto the plain. Han Xin notes that Zhao 'has already taken the favourable ground for its camp'. Position approximate.

zh.name: 赵军壁垒
zh.note: 陈余号称二十万的大军扼守井陉东口、峡道出平原之处。韩信说：“赵已先据便地为壁。”位置为约略。

places.name: Han river camp (背水阵)
places.note: Ten thousand men go out first and deploy with their backs to the river. Where exactly this was is debated; shown approximately on the Mianman river.

zh.name: 背水阵
zh.note: 一万人先行出发，背水列阵。确切地点有争议，图中约略标在绵蔓水畔。

places.name: Hill above the Zhao camp (萆山)
places.note: The two thousand riders go by a hidden path 'and, sheltered by the hill, watch the Zhao army'. The hilltop shown is one that can see the Zhao camp. Position approximate.

zh.name: 萆山
zh.note: 二千轻骑“从间道萆山而望赵军”。图中所标山头是能望见赵营的一处。位置为约略。

places.name: Cavalry hiding place
places.note: Just behind the hill, out of sight of the Zhao camp (see the line of sight). Position approximate.

zh.name: 奇兵隐蔽处
zh.note: 就在山后，赵营望不见（见通视分析）。位置为约略。

places.name: Zhi river
places.note: Where Chen Yu was beheaded after the rout. Position approximate.

zh.name: 泜水
zh.note: 赵军溃败后，陈余被斩于此。位置为约略。

routes.name: Han advance through the defile

zh.name: 汉军东下井陉
zh.note: 韩信、张耳率兵数万，东下井陉。

routes.note: Han Xin and Zhang Er, with several tens of thousands, come down through the defile.

routes.name: Li Zuoche's plan: cut the baggage train

zh.name: 李左车之策：间道绝其辎重
zh.note: 以奇兵三万人从间道截断汉军辎重，主力深沟高垒、坚营不战。陈余没有采纳。

routes.note: Thirty thousand picked troops by side paths to fall on the Han supplies strung out in the defile, while the main army sits tight behind deep ditches. Chen Yu refused.

routes.name: 2,000 light horse by the hidden path

zh.name: 二千轻骑从间道出
zh.note: 夜半出发，人持一面汉军赤帜。

routes.note: At midnight, each rider carrying a red Han banner.

routes.name: Ten thousand deploy with the river behind them
Han Xin drums out of the Jingxing exit, then feigns flight

zh.name: 韩信鼓行出井陉口，佯败
zh.note: 平旦，韩信建大将旗鼓，鼓行出井陉口，大战良久，随后佯弃鼓旗，退入水上军。

routes.note: At dawn Han Xin raises the general's banner, marches out with drums, fights, then abandons drums and banners and falls back to the river camp.

routes.name: Zhao empties its camp to pursue
The riders take the empty camp
routes.note: They pull down the Zhao flags and raise two thousand red Han banners.

zones.name: The Jingxing defile
zones.note: Where Li Zuoche wanted to catch the Han army strung out in column with its supplies behind it.

zh.name: 井陉峡道
zh.note: 李左车想在这里趁汉军拉成长列、粮草在后之时截击它。

steps.title: East through the Taihang
steps.text:
Han Xin and Zhang Er, with several tens of thousands, set out to come down east through Jingxing and attack Zhao. The King of Zhao and Chen Yu gather their army at the Jingxing exit, said to number 200,000.

The map shows the setting: the only road runs down a valley through the Taihang Mountains and comes out onto the plain exactly where Zhao is waiting.

zh.title: 东下井陉
zh.text:
韩信、张耳率兵数万，打算东下井陉攻赵。赵王和成安君陈余听说汉军来袭，聚兵于井陉口，号称二十万。

地图显示了形势：唯一的道路沿河谷穿过太行山，恰好在赵军等候之处出到平原。

steps.title: Li Zuoche: catch them in the defile
steps.text:
Li Zuoche advises Chen Yu: 'On the Jingxing road carts cannot drive two abreast and horsemen cannot ride in ranks; over hundreds of li their grain must trail behind them.' Give him thirty thousand men to go by side paths and cut the baggage, while the main army stays behind deep ditches and high walls; within ten days the two generals' heads would be his.

The cross-section shows how the valley closes in between the mountains on both sides.

zh.title: 李左车：截之于峡道
zh.text:
李左车对陈余说：“今井陉之道，车不得方轨，骑不得成列，行数百里，其势粮食必在其后。”他请求率奇兵三万人从间道断其辎重，主力深沟高垒、坚营不战，不出十日，两将之头可致于麾下。

横剖面显示了河谷如何被两侧山岭夹紧。

steps.title: Chen Yu refuses
steps.text: Chen Yu, a Confucian who says a righteous army does not use tricks, refuses: Han Xin's men are few and exhausted, and avoiding battle would make Zhao look afraid. Han Xin's spies report that the plan was rejected. Only then does he dare to come down the defile, and he halts thirty li short of the exit.

zh.title: 陈余不听
zh.text: 成安君是儒者，常说义兵不用诈谋奇计。他认为韩信兵少而疲，避而不击会让诸侯以为赵国胆怯，于是不听李左车之策。韩信派人探知计策未被采用，大喜，这才敢引兵下井陉，在离井陉口三十里处扎营。

steps.title: Two thousand riders behind the hill
steps.text:
At midnight Han Xin sends two thousand light horse, each carrying a red Han banner, along a hidden path to wait in the cover of the hill and watch the Zhao army. When Zhao empties its camp to chase him, they are to ride in, pull down the Zhao flags and raise the Han red.

The line of sight from the Zhao camp to their hiding place shows the hill blocking the view.

analysis.label: From the Zhao camp to the cavalry's hiding place

zh.title: 二千轻骑伏于山后
zh.text:
夜半，韩信挑选二千轻骑，人持一面汉军赤帜，从间道到山后隐蔽，观望赵军。他告诫说：赵军见我败走，必定倾营追赶，你们就迅速冲入赵营，拔下赵旗，换上汉军赤帜。

从赵营到奇兵隐蔽处的通视分析，显示山体挡住了视线。

steps.title: Backs to the river
steps.text: Han Xin sends ten thousand men ahead; they go out and deploy with the river at their backs, and the Zhao army laughs at them. At dawn he raises the general's banner and marches out of the Jingxing exit with drums beating. Zhao opens its gates and attacks; after a long fight Han Xin and Zhang Er drop their drums and banners and fall back into the river camp, which fights to the death.

zh.title: 背水而陈
zh.text: 韩信令万人先行，出而背水列阵，赵军望见大笑。平旦，韩信建大将旗鼓，鼓行出井陉口。赵军开营出击，大战良久。韩信、张耳佯弃旗鼓，退入水上军，水上军殊死而战，不可击败。

steps.title: Red banners on the Zhao walls
steps.text:
As planned, Zhao empties its camp to seize the Han drums and banners. The two thousand riders gallop into the empty camp and raise two thousand red Han banners. The Zhao army, unable to win and turning back, sees its walls covered in red, panics and breaks.

The viewshed from the hilltop shows what the riders could watch from there.

zh.title: 赵壁尽插汉帜
zh.text:
赵军果然倾营而出，争夺汉军旗鼓。二千奇兵乘虚驰入赵营，拔尽赵旗，立汉赤帜二千。赵军既不能胜，想退回营垒，却见营上全是汉军赤帜，大惊溃乱。

从山头看出去的可视域，显示奇兵在那里能望见的范围。

steps.title: Caught between two forces
steps.text: The Han army attacks from both sides and destroys the Zhao army. Chen Yu is beheaded on the Zhi river, and the King of Zhao, Xie, is captured.

zh.title: 夹击
zh.text: 汉军两面夹击，大破赵军，斩成安君于泜水之上，擒赵王歇。
